=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2629-2680 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_paths` and `_merge_lease_paths_intersect` pass lease paths around as newline-delimited strings and never reject filenames that contain a newline, so a name like `README.md\nagents.d/file` splits into two fragments that both match the default soft class. A clean merge-tree probe can then release the lease even though the real shared path is not soft.
  WHY: All four flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR. They note that the freshness side already fails closed through the `/unsafe-path` jq substitution (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1485), while the lease side has no such guard. That breaks the rule "never let it make a PR skip re-validation when it shares a non-soft path". anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputed this and could not reproduce it: git diff-tree always C-quotes names that hold control characters, so the hard-combined check in `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe` returns `unknown`, and identical content on both heads was already validated by CI. Severity uses the highest rating.
- tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py:1186-1190, 1305-1309 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In SoftPathFreshness.test_a_shared_path_holding_a_comma_is_classified_whole and test_a_shared_hard_path_keeps_shared_paths_without_a_probe, the stubbed `_pr_merge_tree_probe` writes `echo PROBE_CALLED` to stdout. `_pr_base_freshness` sends its stdout to /dev/null (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh line 1885), so `assertNotIn("PROBE_CALLED", out)` can never fail.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this NIT. It is a test-quality defect, not a production one: the "no probe when a hard path is shared" contract goes unenforced, while `assertIn("reason=shared_paths", out)` still covers the classification. The proposed fix is `echo PROBE_CALLED >&2`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan D9 and Phase 4 step 4.1 require lifting the merge-train probe into `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` and keeping the existing `_mt_*` functions as wrappers that map results to `_MT_PROBE_*`; Phase 4 acceptance also requires existing merge-train probe tests to pass through those wrappers.
  expected_change_site: `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` probe functions and `tests/test_review_merge_train.py`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR touches neither file. `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` still holds its own `_mt_git`, `_mt_git_fetch`, `_mt_probe_repo_init`, `_mt_probe_repo_cleanup` and `_mt_conflict_probe` implementations. The agents.d fragment records the wrapper conversion as pending, but these reviewers say the linked issue makes the plan's Phase 4 requirements binding and does not defer this item. minimax_minimax-m3 (confidence 3) adds that the earlier deferral was accepted and that the file is outside files_touched. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not raise it: the file is outside the pipeline plan grant, the deferral is recorded (TASK_GAP_DEFERRED iss_7b76fc6ec8e80091), and the fragment marks it pending.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py:SoftPathFreshness.test_a_shared_path_holding_a_comma_is_classified_whole; test_a_shared_hard_path_keeps_shared_paths_without_a_probe | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stub `_pr_merge_tree_probe() { echo PROBE_CALLED; _PR_PROBE_RESULT=none; }` can only be reached through `_pr_base_freshness`. `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` sends that call's stdout to /dev/null (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh line 1885), so `assertNotIn("PROBE_CALLED", out)` passes whether or not the probe ran.
  WHY: Nothing fails in production, but the no-probe contract for a hard shared path is not enforced. The comma-split regression is still caught by `assertIn("reason=shared_paths", out)`. Fix: `echo PROBE_CALLED >&2`.
- Note: The reviewer disputed the pass-1 MAJOR newline-split claim for `_merge_lease_paths_intersect` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh lines 2657-2667) and could not reproduce it. Its reasoning: git C-quotes names that hold control characters, so `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe` (line 2220 onward) returns `unknown`; delete-versus-modify conflicts; identical content on both heads is already CI-validated.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Plan D9 / step 4.1 is not re-raised: the file is outside files_touched, the gap is deferred as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED iss_7b76fc6ec8e80091, and the agents.d fragment marks it pending.
- HARDENING (2 related items):
  - `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe` diff-tree calls: add `-c core.quotePath=false` so non-ASCII soft paths keep the soft-class benefit (2 lines).
  - `_merge_lease_pr_paths` (lines 2631-2632) and the `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_PR_PATHS` cache (lines 1470-1473): emit the `*` sentinel when a filename matches `[\n\r]` (2-4 lines).
  - HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: The test stubs the probe with `echo`, so `assertNotIn("PROBE_CALLED", out)` always passes.
  WHY: Stdout is sent to /dev/null (line 1885 in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`), so the probe logic goes untested in these cases.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: Plan D9 and Phase 4 step 4.1 require lifting the merge-train probe into `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` and keeping the `_mt_*` functions as wrappers that map results to `_MT_PROBE_*`.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_paths_intersect (approximately lines 2657-2680 in the new file) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `grep -Fx` over newline-delimited strings followed by `_merge_lease_split_soft` splits a path with an embedded newline into soft fragments. On a clean merge, `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe` then releases the lease. The freshness side's `/unsafe-path` guard (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1485) has no equivalent on the lease side.
  WHY: The second PR merges without re-validation, which defeats the guarantee "Any shared non-soft path always keeps today's rule". No lease-side test covers this.

  PROBLEM: The stub's echo never reaches `out` because of the `>/dev/null` at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1885, so `assertNotIn("PROBE_CALLED", out)` cannot fail.
  WHY: This is a test-quality defect. The no-probe invariant is not asserted, while `assertIn("reason=shared_paths", out)` still covers the visible behaviour.

  Requirement: Plan D9 (section 4.1 of docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md): lift the probe into scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh and make the `_mt_*` functions thin wrappers that map `_pr_*` results to `_MT_PROBE_*`; existing merge-train probe tests must pass through the wrappers.

- Note: The reviewer checked the README anchor and `Refs #N` requirement (README.md:164) and concluded no TASK_GAP was warranted. The PR body uses `Refs #9781`.
- HARDENING: `_pr_soft_merge_tree_probe` diff-tree calls: add `-c core.quotePath=false` (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- ASSUMED: Q1 took option A: the orchestrator had already accepted the deferral and `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` is excluded from files_touched. Option B was to widen files_touched.
